verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with an OpenAPI 3.0 reference (jitsu-docs-47, jitsu-docs-61) and an MCP server (jitsu-docs-19), but there is no mention anywhere of API version numbers (e.g., v1/v2) or any documented deprecation policy; a probe for the OpenAPI spec at standard paths also 404'd (jitsu-probe-2). missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme, published deprecation/sunset policy, changelog entries about breaking API changes.
